record.why_relevant: Smallest instances of the target identity; both satisfy the hypothesis n ≥ 1 and confirm the conclusion.
record.where_assumptions_take_effect: Only n ≥ 1 matters; each check is a finite computation.
record.observed_pattern: Partial sums of odd numbers are exactly the perfect squares 1, 4, 9, 16, ...

record.why_relevant: Further small cases confirm the pattern and show each step adds the next odd number 2n−1, matching n² − (n−1)² = 2n − 1.
record.observed_pattern: Difference of consecutive partial sums equals the next odd term — this is precisely the induction step.
